paite: TOUPA' inn ah hoh ni, ka kianga achih lai un ka kipak hi.
heading: David La / Jerusalem Phatna
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”

paite: Jerusalem aw, na kulh kongkhak sung ah ka khete uh adingh hi.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

paite: Jerusalem, khopi bang a lam kiptak a gawmkhawm,
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

paite: TOUPA min phat ding in huai ah namte apaitou ua, TOUPA namte ngei, Israelte kiang a thu theihsakna ding in.
english: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

paite: Huai ah lah vaihawmna a ding in laltutphahte tun ahi ngal a, David inkuanpihte laltutphahte.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

paite: Jerusalem khamuanna ding in ngetsak un; nang hon deihte anavak uhi.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

paite: Na kulh sungte ah khamuanna om henla, na inpite ah navakna om hen.
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

paite: Ka unaute leh ka lawmte ziak in, na sung ah khamuanna om hen, ka chi ding hi.
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

paite: TOUPA i Pathian inn ziak in na hoihna ding ka zong ding.
english: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
